name: Drengr
description: Server-side GTM tag that forwards every GA4-model event this container receives to Drengr, so it lands as a named, queryable event in Drengr's mobile/web analytics platform. No client-side SDK or code change required — just add the tag to a server container that already receives GA4 hits.
notes: Not affiliated with or verified by Google. Intended for the GTM Community Template Gallery once independently tested against a live server container (see README for manual-verification status).
